reuse.why: Adds a new getRangeAmount and calls it from each site instead of routing the sites through the existing getScheduledAmount, which already decides the missing, numeric and ranged cases.

duplication.why: The range rule is shared, but the missing/number/range dispatch that getScheduledAmount already implements stays copied at four server sites.

placement.why: The new rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside getScheduledAmount, which delegates to it.

scope.why: Only the amount rule, its call sites, comments, tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A single range definition is easy to change, but maintainers keep two entry points (getRangeAmount and getScheduledAmount) and four hand-written dispatches that can drift.

bypasses_abstraction.where: forecast-schedules.ts normalizeSchedule, schedules/app.ts updateActions and postTransactionForSchedule, and computeSchedulePreviewTransactions keep their own null/number/range dispatch around getRangeAmount instead of calling getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: The remaining dispatch copies are the pre-existing ones left in place, not reshaped.

one_place.where: The furthest-from-zero rule is defined once in getRangeAmount (shared/schedules.ts) and used by getScheduledAmount and every server site, though each site still dispatches the non-range cases itself.
